slots.title: A Study of Kayfiyyat Ṣalāt al-Nabī ﷺ
slots.description: A focused reading of this treatise on the Prophet's ﷺ prayer as upheld by the Ḥanafī school. Rooted in Qur'an, ḥadīth, early authorities, and sound legal reasoning, the work offers a rigorous defense of the school's method and reaffirms its deep connection to the Sunnah.
